properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The node's entire signature stack: vendored libsecp256k1 (src/secp256k1/**) implementing ECDSA and public-key recovery over the secp256k1 curve, plus application call sites — CKey::Sign via secp256k1_ecdsa_sign with RFC6979 deterministic nonces (src/key.cpp:177), pubkey create/serialize (src/key.cpp:161-163), and CPubKey::Verify (secp256k1_ecdsa_verify) behind every transaction/block/auxpow signature check. Shor-vulnerable: a cryptographically relevant quantum computer forges all signatures, ret

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Sampled across all 44 sites (blockchain.cpp wait conditions, txrequest.cpp tx-hash dedup, QA script hash assertions, secp256k1 recovery module): every comparison is of public values — block/transaction hashes or expected test hashes — never secret-dependent material. Constant-time comparison is not required for public data; recorded as benign posture notes, not vulnerabilities.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 17 sites seen: Python random (Mersenne Twister) for test-data generation in qa/rpc-tests and contrib/testgen (incl. mininode.py:963 peer-version nonce), std::rand in the vendored leveldb issue320 test, and std::rand in the Qt tip-of-the-day picker (src/qt/overviewpage.cpp:169 — cosmetic UI choice). No production security RNG: the node's production randomness is OpenSSL RAND_bytes plus OS entropy (ALG-80605930). Weak PRNG class present in tree, none on a security path.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored libsecp256k1's optional ECDH module — secp256k1 elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman, Shor-vulnerable key agreement. All 14 sites are the library's own artifacts: CI build-matrix switches (.cirrus.yml 'ECDH: yes/no') and the benchmark harness (bench.c 'ecdh' mode, modules/ecdh/bench_impl.h). No secp256k1_ecdh call site exists in the Dogecoin application layer; capability ships with the vendored library. Migration if ever enabled: ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 wrappers (AES128Encrypt/Decrypt, AES128CBC*) over the vendored constant-time ctaes core in src/crypto/aes.cpp/.h, exercised by ctaes benchmarks and unit tests. Available in the shipped library; no production call site found in the application — the wallet cipher is AES-256-CBC. If ever used, Grover halves 128-bit keys to 64-bit effective security.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 14 sites seen: RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA-512 test vectors in src/test/crypto_tests.cpp, exercising the project's own CHMAC_SHA256/CHMAC_SHA512 implementations (src/crypto/hmac_sha256.cpp, hmac_sha512.cpp). QA verification of shipped MACs; production HMAC uses are recorded separately (scrypt PBKDF2 internals, BIP32 HMAC-SHA-512 key derivation).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 9 sites seen: SHA-256 / double-SHA-256 via Python hashlib and pycryptodome in contrib and QA tooling — PNG hash stability checks (optimize-pngs), block hash linearization, base58 double-SHA256 checksums (contrib/testgen/base58.py uses Crypto.Hash.SHA256), auxpow block hashing (auxpow.py), mininode txid/hashing. The node's C++ SHA-256 (src/crypto/sha256.cpp) is the consensus-critical implementation behind every txid/block hash; these sites are the tooling surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-CBC is the wallet encryption cipher: CCrypter::Encrypt (src/wallet/crypter.cpp:85) wraps the master key with PKCS#7-padded AES-256-CBC; key+IV derive from the 25000-round SHA-512 passphrase KDF. Remaining sites are the implementation (src/crypto/aes.cpp wrappers over vendored constant-time ctaes), headers, ctaes benchmarks, and unit-test vectors. CBC is unauthenticated (no AEAD) — legacy wallet format. Quantum posture: 256-bit key retains >128-bit security under Grover; no PQ action need
